title.en: JANUS Connection — Hardened Dependency and Validation Graph
title.ru: JANUS Connection — усиленный граф зависимостей и валидации

graph_thesis: RELATIONAL_SIGNAL -> COLLAPSE_DEPENDENCIES -> BLIND_CONTEXT -> MATCHED_NULL -> RELATION_DESTRUCTION -> CONFOUNDER_CONTROLS -> EXTERNAL_TRANSPORT/REPLICATION

edges.meaning: Boundary trust requires currentness/freshness to be evaluated separately from local authenticity.
Observed signal cannot automatically inherit authority to act.
Externalization addresses self-certification/common-mode risk only when the anchor is outside the relevant failure domain.
Common-mode risk becomes covariance induced by shared selection, representation, classification and detector features.
Archived interpretations can become a context channel for future detections.
If a candidate disappears when prior Connection memory is removed, its source-level residual is weakened.
Residual structure must be evaluated after derivative artifacts and supersession chains are collapsed.
Event-level independence can still overstate evidence when fields are inherited rather than novel.
Minimal sufficient core is built from the smallest novel-information units preserving the relation.
A minimal core is informative only if its operator exceeds schema-matched null recurrence.
Null discrimination is stronger when the relation survives blinding but collapses under targeted relationship destruction.
Externality is temporal as well as physical: the anchor must be independent of and appropriately prior to the target event.
Predecessor history can constrain successor admissibility even when marginal statistics look unchanged.
A temporal relation is not predecessor-specific if breaking it merely creates stale state.
Matched alternative predecessor separates a specific A->B relation from a generic gate on B.
An external corpus reduces JANUS-specific common-mode dependence only after relevant blind transport tests are executed.
Partition survival is an external transport gate, not automatically external replication.
External claims remain limited to the exact transported or replicated operator.
Forbidden inference edges enforce claim ceilings throughout the family.
Cultural analysis supplies a bounded signal-before-judgment operator hypothesis but not empirical support for physical mechanisms.
Fictional/cultural recurrence has zero empirical-replication weight for technical or physical claims.

historical_artifact_edges.reason: Same unit-of-analysis/event-independence theme and reuse of INV-031..035 plus CONN-036..040.
Matched-null discrimination is strengthened into relation-specific rewiring/falsification.
History-wise witness dependence broadens across source families.
Temporal predecessor dependence gains an explicit freshness confounder control.
Five-state freshness-controlled design becomes six-state predecessor-specific design.
External analogy seed becomes an explicit external-corpus structural invariance candidate.
External structural candidate becomes a held-out partition validation design.

interpretation.REAL_1: Candidate exists in untouched source representation.
interpretation.BLIND_1: Candidate does not require the blinded metadata/context.
interpretation.TEMPORAL_REWIRED_0: Candidate is sensitive to destruction of the hypothesized predecessor relation.
interpretation.MATCHED_NULL_0: Candidate is not merely a common schema/operator baseline.
interpretation.FRESHNESS_ONLY_SHUFFLE_1: Candidate survives freshness-only manipulation; otherwise freshness may confound interpretation.
interpretation.ALTERNATIVE_PREDECESSOR_0: Matched wrong predecessor does not preserve the same successor relation.

six_state_temporal_gate.execution_warning: Audited 022/023 records design this benchmark but do not claim a completed full permutation experiment.

external_partition_gate.preferred_profile: effect retained across appropriate held-out partitions and blind representation; matched null absent or materially weaker

independence_model.rule: Two records count as independent only relative to the failure mode and claim being tested. Independence is not a single global boolean.

connection_strength_model.forbidden: single scalar interpreted as probability of truth

machine_decision_rules.if: high detector rank AND low source independence
machine_decision_rules.then: retain DISCOVERED but downgrade independent-support language

machine_decision_rules.if: survives blinding BUT equals matched null
fails both relation rewire AND freshness-only shuffle
machine_decision_rules.then: do not call predecessor-specific; freshness confounding unresolved
prefer generic successor gate interpretation over A-specific edge

machine_decision_rules.if: external corpus is used but partition/null is unexecuted
cultural/symbolic source supplies a matching operator
machine_decision_rules.then: allow interpretive bridge but assign zero empirical-replication weight

negative_space_controls.reason: blinding attacks selected leakage paths only
source externality and executed replication are separate gates
thought-experiment value and empirical evidence are distinct

open_gates: Execute schema-matched null distributions for the strongest historical operator candidates.
Execute relation-specific rewiring rather than only describing it.
Execute the six-state temporal benchmark with continuous effect sizes.
Build artifact-to-source-event and field-level new-information maps.
Execute the Linear A terminology-blind partition benchmark or another external-corpus transport benchmark.
Preserve every failure, collapsed edge and null result alongside surviving connections.
canonical_rule: A Connection becomes stronger by surviving attacks on the reasons it might merely look connected—not by accumulating more internally related JSON files.
